source: Sanzo Wada, A Dictionary of Color Combinations Vol. 1 (Seigensha, 2010; original 'Haishoku Soukan', 1933-34)
note: CMYK values are from the book's index. `hex` is sampled from the scanned index swatches (white-balanced to the paper) and is the recommended on-screen value; `hex_cmyk` is a naive CMYK->RGB conversion, usually more saturated than the print. Colour order inside a combination follows the book's index order, not the plate layout.
